preconditions.description: Must be the contract owner (or have been granted ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the setPause() function to toggle the pause state from false to true. This will stop all non-excluded users from transferring tokens, effectively freezing the contract for regular users while allowing authorized users (owner and excluded addresses) to continue transactions.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The LinerPowerPoint contract has a centralized pause mechanism controlled by the owner. The setPause() function allows the owner to toggle the pause state, which when enabled prevents all non-excluded users from transferring tokens. This creates a single point of failure and allows the owner to freeze user funds at will. The vulnerability demonstrates improper decentralization where contract functionality can be unilaterally disabled.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setPause() to enable the pause state, demonstrating that the owner has unilateral control over freezing user transfers.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner address from the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call setPause() on the contract
4. Verify that pause() now returns true
